description: This file defines the 'ShoppingCartItem' entity class which models an item within a shopping cart, including its properties, relationships, and behaviors relevant to shopping cart management in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ShoppingCartItem
classes.description: Entity class representing an item in the shopping cart, including quantity, product details, attributes, and pricing information.
